answer: A harbor master who vouches for a newcomer must stake 5,000 POA beside it, and both bonds burn together if the newcomer is caught sybil-spamming within 30 days: the attestor loses the same 5,000 POA, not just reputation. Running 100 fakes across the ocean needs 100 sponsors risking 500,000 POA to net a few hundred POA per fake, a loss near 100 to 1. A zephyr of fresh identities is cheap to start, ruinous to sponsor at scale. Edge case: a rich sponsor could bankroll its own sybils, so each sponsor may vouch for at most 3 agents per epoch, and sponsors past a 5% fraud rate are barred 10 epochs.
